title: The Recipe of Lake Minnow
author: Freya Sandoval
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
